original_test_intent: Build the approved ROCm/RVS stack, run GST single configuration at debug level 3, and verify GPU stress/throughput behavior matches the AMD GPU specification.
original_method: Reproduce immutable sources/build, verify `gst_single.conf` workload/target/metric fields, execute exact command once under thermal/power/error monitoring and external watchdog, and compare every GST action and quantitative result with approved model-specific limits.
manual_activity: GPU performance owner approves immutable build/config and model-specific GST metrics, supervises workload/recovery and determines outcome.

Thermal/power/time/error abort, OOB and recovery plan

Use independent watchdog and one attempt
Abort on threshold/hang/error and run deliberate recovery/post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clearly owns gst_single; DeepSeek's generic path is incomplete execution advice rather than alternate source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Immutable artifacts, spec limits and safety approval can be supplied.

review_improvement: Creates a reproducible GST-specific metric oracle while preserving the exact build/config/debug coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: GST is not validated merely because RVS exits successfully: config actions can be skipped and throughput can be below specification without a crash. The config hash, expected action roster and GPU-model metric limits must travel together. Thermal throttling can also depress results without an explicit error, so clocks, temperature and power context are part of interpreting each GST metric.
